'''Flight-predictor sensors''' were a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. They were designed to track and predict the flight path of vehicles. The aerodynamic design of an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder's]] [[mechanical flap]]s gave them the ability to turn without reducing speed, meaning they were nearly impossible for flight-predictor sensors to track.<ref name="SWS" />
